messages:
Maya: Quick alignment for the Optimize public announce — aiming Wed 09:00 PT. Marketing needs the final changelog link, docs landing (with tracking), and one p95 stat + cost-delta blurb by EOD Tue. Who can confirm publish windows?
Sanjay: I can surface the changelog permalink after docs go live. Current PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/412 — wont point until docs URL is final.
Liam: Docs team will publish the Optimize guide today. Targeting Tue 14:00 PT for the canonical URL; well append ?utm_campaign=optimize_v0.9 on handoff.
Olivia: Rollout plan: canary in us-west @ 09:00 PT, 30m watch, then gradual ramp to 100% ~09:30 PT. Canary is reachable but capacity-limited; screenshots should match GA.
Samir: Ill pull p95 snapshots immediately after canary goes live and export a 7-day baseline vs v0.9 CSV for design. Expect screenshots/CSV by Tue 15:00.
Priya: Webinar Thu 10:00 PT. Landing page needs final blurb + CTA to route leads into SDR queue inbound-launch-optimize. Please include tag/campaign in webhook so we can auto-route.
Sanjay: Confirmed. Webhook payload will include "campaign":"optimize_v0.9" and "tag":"optimize-launch" exactly. Ill coordinate schema bump with release-bot.
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: service/optimize v0.9 -> canary us-west @ 2025-11-12T09:00:00-08:00; full rollout @ 2025-11-12T09:30:00-08:00. CI: green.
Maya: Marketing deliverables: blog draft (include p95 and cost delta chart), 4 social tiles, one headline + CTA. Once docs + changelog are posted here with the exact two-sentence blurb, well schedule Wed 09:05 PT.
Olivia: No blockers from eng. Well monitor canary telemetry and hold the ramp if p95 crosses threshold.
Priya: SDR ops: use tag "optimize-launch" and priority P2. Ill confirm routing on the first webhook hit.
Maya: Thanks all. Please drop the final links and the 1-2 sentence blurb in this thread when ready. :rocket:
